newsitem.title: USA: WorldCom Inc Q3 shr rises to $0.27.
newsitem.headline: WorldCom Inc Q3 shr rises to $0.27.

text.p: NOTES: First Call estimate for 1996 Q3 was $0.25.
Average share figures are primary. Diluted average share figures are 415,189,000 for the 1996 third quarter and 390,028,000 for the 1995 third quarter.
1995 net income figure includes a special preferred stock dividend payment. Net income excluding the payment was $68.3 million.
NOTES: 1996 net income is before non-cash charges. 1995 net income excludes a special preferred stock dividend payment.

1996 per share figure excludes non-cash after-tax charge of $344 million or $0.87 per share and a non-cash extraordinary after-tax charge of $24 million or $0.06 per share. Including these charges, 1996 net was a loss of $73.2 million or an $0.18 per share loss.
(All tabled data above 000s except per share numbers)
